description: The 7 March Vontovorona student protest is body-confirmed with exact location, demands, tear-gas dispersal and reported end time, but no crowd count supports the ≥50 threshold.
required_followup: Independent attendance estimate for the Vontovorona site at one time.

description: Newsmada and Midi search-rendered excerpts indicate students returned to the street at Vontovorona on 22 March and mention relative crowd decline only. Both body retrievals failed (Newsmada internal error text includes 406; Midi PDF returned maintenance mode after redirect). No absolute count or continuous chronology is established.
required_followup: Independent accessible report with actual event date, absolute site count, physical end and continuity details. Do not retry the same body URLs or variants.

description: The 30 March body confirms a separate in-campus Vontovorona student demonstration over scholarships and facilities, but attendance is unknown. Language of resumption indicates recurrence, not an uninterrupted campaign.
required_followup: Site-level attendance estimate and evidence on whether separate March dates formed a continuous episode.

description: Four French-led searches covered month/general social issues, 1–15 March, 22 March, English broad terms and Vontovorona. Search effort found concentrated student activity and one cancelled cost-of-living march lead; other provinces/sectors and non-French media remain under-covered.
required_followup: Distinct regional and sector coverage searches if feasible; current negative results do not establish absence.
